name: Trituration with mortar and pestle

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Place the mortar in the zone and hold the pestle. Keep your hand visible.

rules.message: Show your hands to the camera
Keep your hands inside the work zone

steps.title: Grind the drug alone
steps.instruction: Triturate in steady, even circles until the powder is fine.

rules.message: Too fast. Use steady, even pressure
Keep your hands inside the work zone

steps.title: Add diluent (geometric dilution)
steps.instruction: Add the diluent in portions, slowly and calmly.

rules.message: Too fast. Add the diluent calmly
Keep your hands inside the work zone
